entry.title: New: dsh-voice-input-plugin
entry.summary: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop. Exact install spec: @zhangbo-cn/dsh-client-ui-voice-input. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
